mentions.name: react.tv
mentions.description: A web app for creating TV channels from digital media such as YouTube, The Internet Archive, TikTok, Twitch, and Dailymotion by scheduling videos against a custom calendar system. Features include an advanced scheduler that shows when and how long content can play at any datetime, real-time team collaboration, channel libraries for organizing media, dynamic "Blocks" that generate hours of TV-style programming with playback history carried between generations, a catalog for finding media from official YouTube sources, OBS browser-source embedding for restreaming owned content, and options to repeat content infinitely or temporarily to run 24/7 channels.
mentions.problem: Filling out even a month of channel content can be a lot of work, so the author built tooling to make the scheduling process easier.
mentions.audience: Content creators and streamers building 24/7 TV-style channels from online media sources, including teams collaborating on schedules.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://react.tv

It lets you create TV channels from digital media such as YouTube, The Internet Archive, TikTok, Twitch, and Dailymotion. It does that by letting you schedule videos against a custom calendar system.
